<\STATESEP>theory Oblivious
  imports
    Monads.Nondet_In_Monad

begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  oblivious :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> ('a, 'b) nondet_monad \<Rightarrow> bool" where
 "oblivious f m \<equiv> \<forall>s. (\<forall>(rv, s') \<in> fst (m s). (rv, f s') \<in> fst (m (f s)))
                    \<and> (\<forall>(rv, s') \<in> fst (m (f s)). \<exists>s''. (rv, s'') \<in> fst (m s) \<and> s' = f s'')
                    \<and> snd (m (f s)) = snd (m s)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma oblivious_return[simp]:
  "oblivious f (return x)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
